hook: Cut a food out? Plan its return too.

slides.main: 4 elimination diet mistakes that hide your answer.
slides.sub: How to test one suspect food and actually learn something.

slides.main: Cutting out several unrelated suspects at once makes the result hard to read.
slides.sub: Pick one food or group, and change one thing at a time.

slides.main: Set the length before you start, and keep it short.
slides.sub: For a suspected allergy, usually 1 to 2 weeks; for strict low FODMAP, no more than 4 to 6 weeks.

slides.main: Reintroduction is what gives you the answer.
slides.sub: One at a time, a few days apart. Ever had hives or swelling? Only test with a doctor.

slides.main: If nothing improves, stop the diet instead of cutting out more.
slides.sub: Your symptoms may not be related to food, or other factors may be affecting them.

slides.main: Get checked before you start if you have:
items: Blood in your stool or black stools
Symptoms that wake you up at night
